text:
Both summaries are accurate on the main points: the move from two to three office days, the formal-arrangement and claims-team exceptions, the equipment funding change, the hot desking on Levels 3 and 4, and the rationale. Response B says team leaders will set "one common team day," which drops the source's "at least one," though this is minor. Response B also adds lockers and where to direct questions, which are useful but not essential for a busy manager. Response A omits those two details. On length, Response A is about 127 words and Response B about 144, so both exceed the 120-word limit, but B overshoots it more. Response A is the better fit for the brief: it stays closer to the limit, is at least as accurate, and keeps the points the manager needs most.

Verdict: A
